note.zh: 同一场战争开始7天后：被煽动方得到 5055，煽动者得到 5060；各自只在第一次显示窗口，以后改为消息。
note.en: 7 days after the war begins the instigated side gets 5055 and the instigator 5060; each window appears only the first time, later as a message.

scope.en: Exposure roll, both notices and modifiers were checked.
